steps.content: [Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Weightless environment detected... Activating emergency protocols... Deploying cushioning barrier...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: External support detected. Fall risk neutralized... Vital signs scan complete. Chief's vital indicators are within normal parameters.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Projected time to regaining consciousness: three to five minutes.
Before your eyes are two large, furry heads: Meowy and Xiaofeng, flanking you on either side as they peer down at you.
Why are you two here...

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hey, hey, hey. That's the thanks I get for saving your hide? Meowy here caught you clean as a whistle. You sure you didn't smack that pretty head of yours on the way down?
Dizziness still swirling, you slowly push yourself upright until you are sitting.
You find yourself in a snowdrift at the bottom of the cliff, the soft powder a cushion beneath you. Miraculously, your body remains unharmed, without a single scratch.
This is... the base of Mount Fuyun?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Bingo. Lucky I've got eyes in the back of my head. Had Meowy waiting in the hollow, just in case.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: So... what's that thing on you that won't stop beeping?
The Schorl you had almost forgotten peeks out from your collar.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Pleased to reestablish contact. I've synchronized recent offline records and completed a preliminary analysis of the Northwild incident. Your performance was exemplary. The mission objective advanced efficiently without real-time assistance.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Aurum Secretum network has been fully traced. This investigation can be considered a complete success. Additionally, we've obtained critical leads regarding anomalous Sinner activity in Eastia. Overall, a flawless operation.
Schorl hovers in the air with a slow rotation as it delivers its report, while Meowy and Xiaofeng watch with unblinking fascination.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Hmm... though I'm still detecting minor instability, likely originating from the feline entities behind me. Based on available intel, this incident appears isolated. The Eastian Alliance remains a reliable partner.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Local signal strength is still poor. Uploading investigation data gradually. I suggest we return to the Northwild border and rendezvous with support.

options: Not yet. There's something I need to handle.

steps.content: The situation at Northsnow Manor isn't resolved. The ones who gained power through Aurum Secretum are still on that mountain, and Jichuan is up there alone, facing them.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Jichuan... Data confirms she is the Eastian who recently performed my duties under the alias "Shuang'er." I understand your concern. But I must emphasize: this is an internal Eastian matter.
Is that DisCity's stance? Take the intel and walk? That "Eastian" you mentioned, she's been helping me, guiding me toward the truth all this time. I'm not leaving her behind like this.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I understand your position... but this individual has deceived you repeatedly. I must reiterate: this is an internal Eastian affair.
As the cold deepens, Schorl's voice suffers from the low-temperature interference, cutting in and out with bursts of static.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Hey, the little gizmo's got a point. You're an outsider here. What's any of this got to do with you? Walk away now, save us both the headache.
You heard all that, saw Schorl, and you don't seem surprised... How long have you known?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Please. Saw right through you back at the inn. Now that little beggar of yours? She was a lot slicker. Didn't clock her until we crossed fists in the pine grove. Kid's got moves.
So you kept quiet... just to watch the drama unfold?

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Obviously. Where's the fun in spoiling it early? Then I'd miss one of you playing the noble hero and the other the pitiful lamb, building up to that big tearjerker farewell? No thanks.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Look, quit sulking. That girl's tougher than she looks. Taking on those three leftovers? She's got it handled.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This Eastian's manner may be... frivolous, but her judgment is sound. The mission objective has been met. I'll begin compiling your return report.

A flawless operation? A complete success? The more those words reach your ears, the deeper your unease grows. Glancing up, you see the mountain peak has disappeared into the clouds. All daylight is gone, and a bone-chilling cold settles over the wilderness.
In your mind, the memory of Jichuan pushing you off the cliff plays on an endless loop.

The harder she tries to push me away, the more it proves there's something she doesn't want me to see. If... if these people already understand Mania, if they've found ways to awaken Sinners, if their so-called "cultivation" all hinges on contamination deals...
Then why are they so certain Jichuan has something that can push them further?
Schorl falls silent. Out of contact with you for too long, it now needs to sift through all the information it has gathered during these days at the manor.

Everyone except Xiaofeng, who's just here for the show, believes some rumor about the "divine martial arts." That Mania will amplify their cultivation. But no one's actually seen it. No one can prove that Jichuan's practices are even part of them.
Unless what they believe in was never a codex. But a system. Something already tested. A truth no one dares speak aloud.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Information gap confirmed. One critical element is missing from this incident:

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The codex.</color>
[Mountaintop Cliff]

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Is this...what you've all come for... ?
Jichuan stands at the cliff's edge, her figure looking particularly fragile against the bitter wind.
As she produces a scroll, it instantly captures everyone's gaze. The cover bears the title "Snowquell Arts," two words that have, from the very first moment, held an irresistible allure.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: The view from the summit is... quite expansive. A pity, though. Gaze too long, and all that's left is emptiness.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Plum trees that grow among mountain stones must always struggle, their roots breaking through rock for every drop of sustenance. Now... I suppose this will serve as premium fertilizer.

The fertilizer she speaks of is nothing more than the three people standing ten paces away. And yet, none of them dares move. Jichuan dangles the scroll over the cliff's edge, pulling it back and extending it out again—a relentless motion, like someone toying with trapped beasts.
After countless feints, watching greed and desperation ebb and flow across their faces, she finally breaks into laughter.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: What's wrong? No one gives chase? Weren't you all so eager to head down the mountain and capture someone just moments ago?

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: That lad who fell... whether he's dashed on the rocks below or flown to the heavens, who can say? Why waste effort searching for him? But you, Manor Master...
steps.female_content: That girl who fell... whether she's dashed on the rocks below or flown to the heavens, who can say? Why waste effort searching for her? But you, Manor Master...

steps.content: His gaze lands on Jichuan's right hand, clenched tightly into a fist.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: ...That scroll in your hand holds a far greater weight than some lad of unknown origin.
steps.female_content: ...That scroll in your hand holds a far greater weight than some girl of unknown origin.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Manor Master Jiang, let's not mince words. Your inner flame gutters like a candle in the wind. Hand over the codex, and I'll personally see to it you have a dignified burial, a plot worthy of the Shen family name.

Jichuan covers her mouth with her fingers and coughs softly. Droplets of blood fleck the snow, vivid crimson against the perfect white. Still, she smiles; that newly forged connection within her tempers the sharp anguish of the contamination.
It seems the young hero has been keeping secrets from her as well. Does that make them even? She lifts her gaze, meeting three pairs of murderous eyes with unruffled calm.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: What you seek is indeed here.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: But I wonder... this "ascension in one step"... which of you has the fate to claim it, and which of you... has the fate to enjoy it?

With that, the remaining blossoms at the cliff's edge shudder and ascend, bursting into bloom as a red mist that fills the sky. As the dazzling red overwhelms their sight and seizes their focus for a heartbeat, a fierce strike from a staff shatters the haze, hurtling directly toward them.
